applicableClauses.note: Borealis Care covers one accidental-damage incident, such as a drop that cracks the screen, within the first 12 months from purchase. The product was bought about 10 months ago and no earlier accidental-damage incident is known.
24-month warranty period in all regions. warranty_lookup reports the claim date within standard coverage.
A screen cracked in a drop is not a manufacturing defect; coverage comes from the accidental-damage clause instead.
No liquid contact reported or visible.
No repair or opening by an unauthorized party is reported.

structuredOutput.summary: Covered: the cracked screen is accidental damage, which Borealis Care covers once within the first 12 months from purchase under POL-6; the claim is made about 10 months after purchase. The Borealis policy lists no accidental-damage exclusion; the liquid and unauthorized-repair exclusions (POL-3, POL-4) do not apply.
